prompts.x: Create a 10-second vertical (9:16) video. Scene: [funny situation, e.g. a cat as a stressed manager]. Camera: slow push-in, quick cut at 5 seconds. Style: realistic, bright light, shallow depth of field. Exaggerated facial expressions, a comedic pause at the end. No text on screen.
Cinematic drone shot flying through [city] at golden hour. Smooth forward motion, glowing windows, light haze, 35mm film look, subtle lens flare, highly detailed. 10 seconds, 24fps.

prompts.u: Animate a product image into a short ad.
prompts.x: Using the attached product photo, make an 8-second premium ad. The product rotates slowly on a clean [color] surface with soft rim lighting and floating particles. Gentle camera orbit. Final frame holds centered with space for a logo.

Create a 6-shot storyboard for a 30-second video about [topic]. For each shot give: visual description, camera movement, on-screen text and a voiceover line under 12 words. Tone: [friendly / bold / calm].

16:9 thumbnail. Subject: [person or object] with a surprised expression on the right third. Background: [color] gradient with soft glow. Bold 3-word text '[your text]' on the left in thick white font with dark outline. High contrast, sharp focus.
Professional studio photo of [product] on a [white / pastel / marble] background. Soft diffused light, natural shadow, centered composition, 4K, ecommerce catalog style. No text, no watermark.

prompts.u: Show a product in everyday use.
prompts.x: Candid lifestyle photo of a [age] [person] using [product] in a [bright kitchen / gym / office]. Natural window light, shallow depth of field, warm color grade, realistic skin texture.

prompts.u: Quick brand directions to react to.
prompts.x: Minimal vector logo concept for a brand called [name], a [type of business]. Simple geometric mark, [two colors], flat design, white background, centered, no mockup, no extra text.

prompts.u: Ideas to test in your next campaign.
prompts.x: Act as a direct-response marketer. Product: [product]. Audience: [who]. Give 10 ad angles (pain point, curiosity, social proof, comparison, speed, price and others). For each: a one-line hook and a 25-word script.

prompts.u: Short copy for a store page.
prompts.x: Write a product description for [product]. Include a one-line headline, 3 benefit bullets (not features), one short paragraph on who it is for and a closing line. Tone: friendly and clear, no hype words. Max 120 words.

Write a 30-second vertical video script about [topic]. Structure: 3-second hook, the problem, a 3-step solution, call to action. Add on-screen text and b-roll ideas per line. Spoken style, short sentences.
I will paste 3 competitor ads. For each, list the hook, the offer, the emotion it targets and why people stop scrolling. Then suggest a better version for [my product] and end with a summary table.

prompts.u: Test an idea before spending money.
prompts.x: I'm considering selling [product] to [audience]. List 5 reasons it could work, 5 risks, the 3 biggest competitors to check, and 5 questions to answer with real customer research before spending on ads.
